risks.title: Overall AOI coverage is not approved
risks.detail: OSM/OS building and road feature counts have not been checked. Keep selection_status selected_pending_coverage and coverage_status not_checked.

risks.title: Performance depends on the graphics path
risks.detail: The TVW-008 handback records 60 FPS on this host's hardware-accelerated Chrome and a 9.4 FPS median on SwiftShader software rendering.

risks.title: Real source package is local
risks.detail: EA source downloads and the generated terrain package are not committed; a clean clone uses synthetic terrain until sources are restored and rebuilt.

forecastNotes: Ranges include implementation, quality gates and one independent review/fix cycle; assume public OSM coverage is usable and no account-gated fallback is needed.
These are planning ranges, not calendar commitments. Sparse source coverage or extra performance/review fixes can extend them.
